Class DeleteTaskDialog

java.lang.Object
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.Dialog
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.DeleteTaskDialog
public class DeleteTaskDialog extends Dialog
Asks before a task is deleted, naming it, since a delete cannot be undone. The red button deletes it; Cancel and Escape leave it.
Author:
Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan
